name: Dusk
description: Kokedera Dusk brings deep forest greens, weathered stone, and lantern light to VS Code, JetBrains and Zed—the temple's first and quietest palette.

name: Morning
description: Kokedera Morning brings warm paper grounds and ink-like moss greens to VS Code, JetBrains and Zed—a calm, readable palette for first light.

name: Night
description: Kokedera Night brings near-black grounds, bright greens, and warm lantern contrast to VS Code, JetBrains and Zed for focused work after dark.

name: Spring
description: Kokedera Spring brings fresh growth, clear greens, and cherry-blossom pink to VS Code, JetBrains and Zed—a lively season held in quiet balance.

name: Summer
description: Kokedera Summer brings dense, saturated moss greens and a cool teal stream to VS Code, JetBrains and Zed for a vivid workspace in deep green.

name: Autumn
description: Kokedera Autumn brings rust, amber, and ember accents over dark earth to VS Code, JetBrains and Zed—a warm palette shaped by turning maples.

name: Winter
description: Kokedera Winter brings snow-pale grounds, steel blue, and a quiet red to VS Code, JetBrains and Zed for a cool, clear, light editor palette.

name: Rain
description: Kokedera Rain brings wet teal, blue-green shadows, and reflected lantern warmth to VS Code, JetBrains and Zed—a dark palette after rainfall.

name: Mist
description: Kokedera Mist brings muted grey-greens and blue-grey distance to VS Code, JetBrains and Zed—a soft, desaturated palette for quiet, steady focus.
